== Spawners ==
[[File:Image of a cow spawner.png|thumb|Image of a cow spawner]]
In DonutSMP, there are items called spawners. These, when placed, will mimic the mob drops of the spawner mob, but won't actually spawn entities to reduce lag. Instead, you can right-click to access the mob drops like opening a chest.

There are eight types of spawners:
* Pig Spawner - gives raw pork
* Cow Spawner - gives raw beef
* Spider Spawner - gives spider eyes & string
* Zombie Piglin Spawner - gives gold nuggets
* Skeleton Spawner - gives bones and arrows
* Blaze Spawner - gives blaze powder
* Creeper Spawner - gives gunpowder
* Iron Golem Spawner - gives iron ingots

For people with large amounts of spawners, you can 'stack' up to the (signed) 32 bit integer with the same type of spawner in one block by holding shift + right-click, causing it to produce a bit more of the mob drops. However, keeping all your spawners in one place is really risky as spawners are pie-chartable and if your base gets raided, you lose everything, and also reasons stated below. This is the main reason that people either want Donut+ or Media+ so much, as it effectively gives them twice the amount of homes, allowing them to spread out their spawners more, reducing the chance of losing potentially hundreds of millions of dollars worth of spawners.

'''Keeping spawners in multiple piles give more bones'''

'''There is an equation for how many bones skeleton spawners make per minute. The equation is "-0.39567e^{\left(-0.00134606x+8.24358\right)}+1505.35". Plugging that into Desmos will give you an exponential graph that slows down as the x-value (bones per minutes) increases. This means that for each additional spawner added to a single stack, the marginal increase in bones per minute decreases.  The horizontal asymptote (aka how many bones per minute spawners can make in one stack) is at 1505.35, the effective cap of bones per minute with a single stack of spawners.''' 

'''The Y-axis represents the bones per minute and the X-axis represents the spawners in one pile.'''

'''Visualize two spawner piles - one has only two spawners, so adding another will add 2.3 bones per minute to the total production. If we already have 1,000 spawners in the pile and we add one more, that same spawner we add will only add 0.9 bones per minute to the total production. Because of this, it is much more beneficial to spread out spawners across multiple piles.'''

'''Spawners are considered as in different piles as long as they aren't in the same block. You don't need them to be many chunks apart, you only need them to be separated. They can just be 2 blocks next to each other.'''

=== Common misconceptions ===
* Contrary to popular belief, cow spawners don't actually give leather; you need to kill actual cows for that.
* Also, blaze spawners don't give blaze rods; rather, they give blaze powder.
